Risk: Upstream Transparency Issues (ID: credo-risk-047)
Description: The AI system's upstream providers or components in the value chain may lack transparency, potentially increasing uncertainty and risk, and making it challenging to assess the system's compliance, performance, or security.
Concern: None
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Axis: Third-party agent (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/ThirdPartyAgent)
Roles: agent
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/CalculationAgent: calculation agent
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/Custodian: custodian
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/SecurityUnderwriter: security underwriter

Axis: Basket of credit risks (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/MarketIndices/BasketIndices/BasketOfCreditRisks)
Roles: object
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: hasMember -> CreditIndexConstituent
Siblings:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/DER/CreditDerivatives/CreditDefaultSwaps/BasketOfCreditDefaultSwaps: basket of credit default swaps
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/Baskets/BasketOfSecurities: basket of securities
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/ForeignExchange/ForeignExchange/ExchangeRateStructure: exchange rate structure
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/Indicators/Indicators/TermStructure: term structure
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Accounting/CashFlows/CashFlowStructure: cash flow structure
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/Baskets/MixedBasket: mixed basket
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/EconomicIndicators/EconomicIndicators/FixedBasket: fixed basket
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccounts/TransactionRecord: transaction record
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/IND/Indicators/Indicators/PriceStructure: price structure
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/GreenLoans/SustainabilityPerformanceTarget: sustainability performance target
